evidence.comparison: Palantir; industrial AI; knowledge graph (English, all categories)
evidence.input_type: Exact search terms, not Google Trends topics
evidence.result: Reviewed in Google Trends Explore on 1 November 2026. Palantir had the strongest displayed interest. Related queries were heavily about shares and general news and were rejected. Knowledge graph related queries included what is a knowledge graph and graphrag. Retain explanatory graph language; no volume or market inference.

evidence.comparison: Palantir; industrial AI; knowledge graph (English, all categories)

evidence.result: Reviewed in Google Trends Explore on 1 November 2026. Palantir again dominated this comparison. evidence.comparison: Palantir; industrial AI; knowledge graph (English, all categories)
evidence.input_type: Exact search terms, not Google Trends topics
evidence.result: Reviewed in Google Trends Explore on 1 November 2026. Palantir dominated; knowledge graph showed sparse reporting. Industrial AI related queries included manufacturing, industrial robotics and industrial automation. Unrelated stock, conflict and news queries were excluded. The low specialist signal is not zero demand.

limitations: Sampled normalized interest, not absolute volumes. German-language variants are source-based editorial synonyms and were not measured in these English comparisons.
